name: SUN397: Scene Categorization Benchmark
description: The Scene UNderstanding (SUN) 397 benchmark is a comprehensive scene categorization dataset comprising 108,754 images spanning 397 well-defined scene categories, with at least 100 images per category. Developed at Princeton University, it serves as a foundational benchmark for scene recognition, indoor vs. outdoor classification, and visual context modeling.
